action: The eagle proudly presents a big golden trophy cup out in front of its chest, holding it with both wings, one wing on each side of the cup, trophy centered and clearly visible, eagle facing forward beaming with a small happy bounce, the trophy sparkles, holds it steady, then lowers it and settles. The trophy is a large, clearly visible golden cup with two handles, about as big as the eagle's head. The eagle's feathers, face and beak keep their normal colors the whole time with no glow, no aura and no light effects on the eagle; only the trophy shines. The branch and feet never move.
